Dukaan kab khulti hai?

Radhe Auto Parts & Kirana Store roz subah 6:30 AM se raat 11:00 PM tak khuli rehti hai, hafte ke saatho din.

Dukaan kahan hai?

Radhe Chowk, Odgi, Girjapur, Chhattisgarh 497231. Website par "Map par Dekhein" ya Google Maps wale card par tap karke seedha directions mil jaate hain.

Kaun kaun si services milti hain?

Bike repairing aur servicing, engine oil change, clutch aur brake adjustment, puncture aur tyre-tube ka kaam, bike washing aur cycle repair, sab ek hi dukaan par.

Kaun se products milte hain?

Engine oil (Amaron, Motul, Elf, Hero, Goetze, Valvoline, Idemitsu), LED aur fog lights, bike tyres, alloy wheels, brake shoe, chain sprocket, ignition coil aur Hero genuine parts. Saath me roz ka kirana saman bhi.

Products ka rate kaise pata karein?

Har product ke saath rate nahi likha hai. Rate ke liye call karein ya "Inquire / Buy" par tap karke WhatsApp par poochh lein.

Service slot kaise book karein?

"Book Service Slot" button par tap karein, apna naam, bike model, service aur time bharein. Details WhatsApp par khulengi aur wahin confirm hoga.

Kya WhatsApp par order ya inquiry ho sakti hai?

Ji haan. Kisi bhi product par "Inquire / Buy" ya upar ke menu me WhatsApp button se seedha message kar sakte hain.

Kirana store me kya milta hai?

Rashan, chai-nashta, namkeen, soap-detergent, cold drinks aur packaged food. Kirana ke liye alag number par call ya WhatsApp bhi kar sakte hain.
